findings.body: Adding `pub reasoning_effort: String` without a `#[serde(default)]` attribute makes the field required when deserializing existing config files. Users with a config written before this change will get a parse error because the field is missing. Since the field is new, backward compatibility requires a default value (likely `"off"` to preserve prior behavior). Consider adding `#[serde(default = "default_reasoning_effort")]` or a similar default.
